newsitems.title: Состоялся релиз DLC The Viking Sagas для Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition с тремя новыми цивилизациями
newsitems.contents:
Дополнение The Viking Sagas для Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition вышло 22 сентября 2026 года. Оно посвящено Северной Европе эпохи викингов и рассказывает историю Харальда Сурового, который стремился стать величайшим викингом в истории.

В состав DLC вошли три новые цивилизации — Даны, Саксоны и Варяги . Каждая получила уникальные юниты, технологии и общую региональную архитектуру. Даны делают ставку на стремительные дальние рейды на драккарах: их пехота и осадные орудия сильны, а уничтожение вражеских зданий приносит дополнительное золото и ресурсы. Саксоны, напротив, славятся крепкими укреплениями и пехотными армиями: система фирда позволяет быстро набирать солдат из городов и поместий, а реформы Альфреда Великого дали им флот, способный бросить вызов даже датчанам. Варяги выбрали восточное направление — они торговали и селились от Балтики до Чёрного и Каспийского морей, получая дополнительный доход из разных источников и обладая одной из лучших кавалерии, флотов и гвардейских дружин.

Ключевая часть дополнения — эпическая кампания из 15 сценариев, разделённая на три части: «Принц в изгнании», «Жестокий правитель» и «Последний викинг». Игрок проведёт Харальда от юности через заснеженные поля сражений Скандинавии и улицы Константинополя до решающей битвы за английский престол в 1066 году. По пути он обретёт братьев по оружию — сурового христианина Ульва Оспакссона и пылкого язычника Халльдора Сноррасона — и докажет, что достоин прекрасной Эллисив, княжны Киева.

Помимо цивилизаций и кампании, авторы переработали фракцию викингов, сделав её более смертоносной и аутентичной. Для редактора сценариев добавили десятки новых ассетов, включая выгоревшие здания и горящих птиц. Дополнение The Viking Sagas уже доступно в Steam.

newsitems.title: The Viking Sagas Available Now For Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition!
newsitems.author: Lady Eridani
newsitems.contents:
[previewyoutube=R4pyWSFtS7U;full][/previewyoutube]
New lands and plunder await! [i][b]The Viking Sagas[/b][/i] DLC for [b][i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i][/b] is available now, bringing three brand new civilizations, 15 new single player campaign scenarios, and much more!

[b][i]The Viking Sagas[/i][/b] introduces three formidable new civilizations with their own unique units, technologies, and shared architecture. The [i]Danes[/i], sail swift longships to raid and pillage your enemies’ lands to your heart’s content. The [b]Saxons[/b], construct mighty fortified towns and unify England in the face of ruthless Scandinavian invasions. And the [b]Varangians[/b], fearlessly navigate Europe’s waterways, ride down your foes, and enlist as mercenaries to wealthy empires.

Relive the legend of [b]Harald Hardrada[/b] in a sweeping 15 scenario three-campaign epic, taking you across the medieval world: battle in the blood-soaked winter battlefields of Scandinavia, serve as an elite Varangian in the mighty city of Constantinople, and face your destiny in the ultimate Viking invasion of England. 

To the oars! [b]Seize new adventure in [i]The Viking Sagas[/i], available now![/b]

[url=https://www.ageofempires.com/news/age-of-empires-ii-definitive-edition-update-185872/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/00114bbc2da7cf71f08926f30fc70ef44506b86e.png[/img][/url]

[hr][/hr]
[h1]The Viking Sagas Is Available Now![/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4376980/Age_of_Empires_II_DE__The_Viking_Sagas/
[hr][/hr]

[h1]Included in The Viking Sagas[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/73cb702accf88d4f80b7d08d8c5143f12dd6e666.jpg[/img]

[i]The Viking Sagas[/i] is a DLC set in Northern Europe primarily during the Viking Age, and follows the journey of Harald Hardrada and their challenge to become the greatest Viking there ever was. Three new civilizations masters of warfare on land and at sea join the roster, and the [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i]‘s core unit roster expands along with several unique and region-specific assets representing the iconic features of each region.

Here’s what you can expect at a glance!
[list][*] Three new civilizations: Danes, Saxons, Varangians
[list][*] Vikings civilization rework — now deadlier and more authentic[/list]
[*] Three epic campaigns, one legendary hero: Harald Hardrada
[list][*] Shape Harald’s rise from hopeful youth to hardened warrior-king[/list]
[*] New regional units: Varangian Guard, Mounted Crossbowman, and Longship
[list][*] Raid and pillage your way to Valhalla![/list]
[*] Dozens of new scenario editor assets!
[list][*] Burnt-out buildings — no Viking DLC is complete without a good raid![/list]
[*] Flaming birds![/list]
[quote][h3]Read more about everything coming with [i]The Viking Sagas[/i] DLC for [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i] here:[/h3]

[url=https://www.ageofempires.com/news/pre-order-age-of-empires-ii-definitive-edition-the-viking-sagas/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/096b6eb456a540597d7999b7b680b751ba2ac4a7.png[/img][/url][/quote]

[h1]The Three-part Epic Campaign of Harald Hardrada[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/f4aca6449058f5afe1fad78a63fdfaa0abaf9a34.jpg[/img]
As the sun sets on the Viking age, Harald Hardrada embarks on an odyssey to become the greatest Viking there ever was. Sail the dramatic fjords of Scandinavia, fight your way through the streets of magnificent Constantinople, and seize the throne of England in the decisive year 1066! Forge bonds of brotherhood with the stoic Christian Ulf Ospaksson and passionate pagan Halldor Snorrason; throw your axe against hordes of fierce enemies; and prove yourself worthy of beautiful Ellisif, the princess of Kyiv.

[quote][h3]We shared more information about exactly what you can expect in this thrilling three-part campaign epic, Part 1: The Exiled Prince, Part 2: The Hard Ruler, and Part 3: The Last Viking, in the Campaign Preview here:[/h3]

[url=https://www.ageofempires.com/news/the-viking-sagas-campaign-preview/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/9e17f48a6b53e93e702ea4a3685c2031dc8532c7.png[/img][/url][/quote]

[h1]The Danes[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/e2a842f2429e3bd53b99ade82d7b82f0925d0662.jpg[/img]
Feared across northern Europe for their aggressive expansion and brutal raids during the Viking Age, the Danes dominate the North Sea region with stout infantry and powerful siege engines. Centuries of coastal raiding makes them swift sailors, while a tradition of hunting, gathering, and farming makes their Fishing Ships and Villagers more productive at gathering food. True to their reaving nature, the Danes are expert pillagers, plundering gold and resources from every destroyed building.

[quote][h3]Curious for more details on the new Danes civilization? We’ve written a dedicated blog where we get into the nitty-gritty details, read more in our deep dive here:[/h3]

[url=https://www.ageofempires.com/news/danes-civilization-deep-dive/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/a5047c692dc473099f8696222b8628deb537be52.png[/img][/url][/quote]

[h1]The Saxons[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/e65514eb476d522f1109d9fb4b95a1695099dbfa.jpg[/img]
Prosperous inheritors of Roman Britain, the Saxons use strong fortifications and infantry armies to vigilantly guard their realms against the constant threat of Viking raids. The organized and efficient fyrd system facilitates levying foot soldiers from Saxon towns and estates, while Alfred the Great’s naval reforms have created a fleet capable of challenging even the Danes at sea. Resilient and adaptive, the Saxons may bend but won’t break, and present a stiff challenge to any invader.

[quote][h3]Ready to lead the new Saxons civilization to victory? You can learn more about what makes them unique in [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i] in our dedicated deep dive here:
[/h3]

[url=https://www.ageofempires.com/news/saxons-civilization-deep-dive/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/c31e183021dd60301615698fed208799b4ffdd14.png[/img][/url][/quote]

[h1]The Varangians[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/589b8a0ad493727f04228cafa895c37c940460e9.jpg[/img]
The intrepid Varangian adventurers turned their sights east rather than west, navigating the Baltic Sea and the rivers of Russia to settle and trade in lands as far away as the Black and Caspian Seas. A keen eye for commerce elicits extra gold income from a variety of sources, while their cavalry, navy, and Varangian Guards are among the best in the business. Through trade, raiding, and settlement, the Varangians left a lasting influence throughout much of medieval eastern Europe.

[quote][h3]Want to learn more about the new Varangian civilization for [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i]? You’re in luck! You can read all about their design and playstyle in our deep dive here:[/h3]

[url=https://www.ageofempires.com/news/varangians-civilization-deep-dive/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/108deb373f7cdbb51427374c8e09108242ba3bd6.png[/img][/url][/quote]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/6025811613a3ae71f83fe73616ea5255e0abe0a0.jpg[/img]
Welcome fellow [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i] players! This time we are sailing the seas, raiding the shores and earning our place in Valhalla with a Viking-themed content update. Seek shelter under the new Scandinavian architecture set, raid and plunder enemy shores with the new Varangian Guard infantry, and revolutionize medieval warfare with the addition of the Mounted Crossbowman regional unit available to 12 existing European civilizations!

The newest DLC, [i]The Viking Sagas[/i], is available now! But changes aren’t only coming from the north! We are charting a course through a boatload of new content, bringing down the hammer on bugs, and making quality of life improvements– including an AI and pathfinding rework!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4376980/Age_of_Empires_II_DE__The_Viking_Sagas/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/73cb702accf88d4f80b7d08d8c5143f12dd6e666.jpg[/img][/url]

Here are some of the big highlights coming with this month’s update:
[list][*] New Varangian Guards and Mounted Crossbowmen Regional Units.
[*] Longboats are renamed Longships and are now available for Vikings, Danes, Saxons and Varangians.
[*] New architecture set for Danes, Varangians, and Vikings.
[*] New ship animations, regional wildlife and terrain elements.
[*] New voice lines for Byzantines.
[*] Core pathfinding mechanics updates and AI enhancements.
[*] New Arabian Desert map.
[*] Improved Multiplayer Lobbies file transfer speeds.[/list]
Be sure to dig down into the post below to get all of the smaller details before hopping in-game and checking them out firsthand. See you all on the battlefield, [i]Til bardaga[/i]!

[quote][b]This is just a small taste of what is coming in the latest update. For a more complete list, please visit our site and check out our blog. Happy Gaming![/b]

[h1]Jomsviking[/h1]
[table equalcells=1 noborder=1][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/b26aa4a07e44949f68f4e26f445382ea3d727fa1.png[/img][/td][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/67cfaa4917ada8306fe927fb3289754a23410d8a.png[/img][/td][/tr][tr][td]Jomsvikings[/td][td]Jomsvikings attack an unprepared village[/td][/tr][/table]
The[b] Jomsviking[/b] is a powerful infantry unit available to the [b]Danes[/b] at the [b]Castle[/b].

Established in the 10th century by King Harald Bluetooth, the Jomsvikings were a legendary mercenary brotherhood bound by a strict, ruthless code, and were “looked on as the greatest of warriors”. These hardened men spent their summers mercilessly raiding foreign lands and earned renown as the finest fighters of their age. Their exceptional bravery in the face of danger, but also fair code of brotherhood made them famous in sagas and legendary narratives.

In-game, the Jomsvikings mirror this peerless reputation. Armed with a spear and large shield, they form a durable front line with exceptional capabilities against enemy cavalry, making them ideal to pair with siege engines. Reflecting their raiding capabilities, Jomsvikings throw torches to quickly incinerate enemy buildings or ships. This synergy with the civilization bonus of looting from razed buildings is a formidable tool in the Danes’ arsenal.

[h1]Jarl[/h1]
[table equalcells=1 noborder=1][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/598baa1768a5daec27a989f004cc65249ac6a5a3.png[/img][/td][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/e52f2332b5a825ccfb45e1efa2c2e78d3e166fbd.png[/img][/td][/tr][tr][td]Jarl[/td][td]A feud between Jarls and Berserks[/td][/tr][/table]

The [b]Jarl[/b] is an elite axe-hurling cavalry unit available at the [b]Castle[/b] for the [b]Varangians[/b].

In Old Norse society, the Jarl was a regional warlord of immense power, ranking directly beneath the king. As high-status administrators and cultic leaders, they possessed the independence to muster their own warbands and the wealth to equip them. Often mounted on great horses and clad in elaborate armor, these noblemen were not just commanders, but elite warriors who rode into battle with the finest weaponry the era could produce.

In the game, the Jarl functions as a heavily armored cavalry unit that excels at defeating enemy infantry. Armed with throwing-axes, they can swiftly ride into battle, hurl their axes at range, and disengage if needed. While they wear durable armor and deal high damage at range, they work best when protected by other units. Many of the Varangians’ units are vulnerable to infantry, which makes the Jarl a formidable complementary choice.

[h1]Hearth Troop[/h1]
[table equalcells=1 noborder=1][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/e3f3b5df2906dcb39175896e3015f272d07ac19c.png[/img][/td][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/7832baefdb7978bdf4853518695e7d93313dba7e.png[/img][/td][/tr][tr][td]Hearth Troops[/td][td]Hearth Troops engage a Viking force[/td][/tr][/table]

The [b]Hearth Troop [/b]is a heavy and slow moving infantry that hurls javelins before engaging in melee combat, available at the [b]Castle[/b] for the [b]Saxons[/b].

Derived from the Old English heorþwerod, these full-time professional soldiers served as the iron core of pre-Norman English armies, especially during the Heptarchy period. Immortalized in epic poems like The Battle of Maldon, they were bound by blood and gold to their ring-giving leader. Their kings lavished them with the finest gear available, ensuring every Hearth Troop was clad in high-end battle-gear that reflected the immense wealth and generosity of their lord.

In-game, the Hearth Troops demonstrate the weight of this elite status, as they boast exceptional armor that makes them incredibly durable. Though weighed down by their armor, Hearth Troops mitigate this lack of speed by hurling a long range javelin before engaging in melee combat. This lethal opening volley can be used to soften up approaching enemies, and is especially potent against enemy ranged soldiers.

[h1]Varangian Guard[/h1]
[table equalcells=1 noborder=1][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/6e7ba7657622b811cc1cb7f03d4416291273afe5.png[/img][/td][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/c4664f33eec552d2bd3343e99e15d5f80671a43e.png[/img][/td][/tr][tr][td]Varangian Guards[/td][td]Varangian Guards parry an enemy attack[/td][/tr][/table]

The [b]Varangian Guard[/b], first available in the [b]Castle Age[/b], is trained at the [b]Barracks[/b] for the Vikings, [b]Byzantines[/b], and [b]all civilizations[/b] in [i]The Viking Sagas[/i].

Originally founded by Emperor Basil II, these fearless bodyguards were primarily Scandinavians who journeyed to Byzantium in search of power and treasure. Their name stems from the Old Norse [i]væringi[/i], rooted in the word for “oath”, signifying their unwavering loyalty to the Emperor. Equipped with a variety of weapons, especially deadly Dane axes, they also carried shields for protection in close formation. Their ranks famously included Harald Hardrada, the future King of Norway, whose exploits exemplified the lethal effectiveness of this legendary corps. Later in its existence, the Varangian Guard also drew formidable recruits from Anglo-Saxon England.

In-game, Varangian Guards are swift-moving shock infantry capable of dealing massive damage with their heavy axes. Reflecting their history of accruing vast riches, they are able to generate gold during combat, but are vulnerable to the Militia-line.

[h1]Longship[/h1]
[table equalcells=1 noborder=1][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/78fa41d7bf191216511eb7c20d928893b2a33835.png[/img][/td][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/786f69a380ea185ab75726b0ec6b9f2c4a77db02.png[/img][/td][/tr][tr][td]Longships[/td][td]Longships on a river raid[/td][/tr][/table]

The [b]Longship[/b], first available in the [b]Castle Age[/b], is constructed at the [b]Dock[/b] for the [b]Vikings[/b], and [b]all civilizations[/b] in [i]The Viking Sagas[/i].

Known as the [i]dreki[/i] or “dragon-ship,” this vessel was the technological marvel that allowed the Norsemen to dominate the seas during the Viking Age. Masterfully “clinker-built” with overlapping oak and pine planks, they possessed a uniquely shallow draft that allowed them to cross open oceans and navigate up shallow rivers with equal ease.

Though one of the original unique units, the Longship now brings its naval capabilities to multiple civilizations. Staying true to its history as a nimble but powerful raiding vessel, this ship fires multiple arrows at unsuspecting victims.

[h1]Mounted Crossbowman[/h1]
[table equalcells=1 noborder=1][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/13eee5a659d078b122d3d8b63277920f6e289e43.png[/img][/td][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/f7ff4675fd6d3710b59b027539de6d3a16999383.png[/img][/td][/tr][tr][td]Mounted Crossbowman[/td][td]Mounted Crossbowmen engage enemy infantry[/td][/tr][/table]

The [b]Mounted Crossbowman[/b], first available in the [b]Castle Age[/b], is trained at the [b]Archery Range[/b] for the [b]Vikings[/b], and [b]all civilizations[/b] in [i]The Viking Sagas[/i], as well as most other European civilizations.

At the turn of the first millennium CE, the crossbow began to supplant the traditional bow in European royal armories, offering a deadly combination of cheap cost, ease of use, and power. Unlike the physical strain required for a war bow, the crossbow allowed a warrior to hold a cocked shot indefinitely and fire from protected positions or from horseback. While this mechanical advantage allowed for superior aim, it came with the significant drawback of a much slower fire rate compared to a skilled horse archer. Despite this, the accessibility of this weapon and its lethality in combat made it a wildly popular investment for medieval European armies.

In-game, Mounted Crossbowmen fire heavy-hitting bolts that are effective against a variety of units. While their equipment slows them down compared to Cavalry Archers, Mounted Crossbowmen are still mobile enough to be effective in combat. In the Imperial Age, the “Cranequins” technology allows them to fire more powerful crossbows, adding to their range and anti-infantry damage.

[h1]Heroes (Campaign-exclusive Units)[/h1]
[table equalcells=1 noborder=1][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/f4aca6449058f5afe1fad78a63fdfaa0abaf9a34.jpg[/img][/td][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/cb70a3b9436d707e5a4aa52e1f2dace55cc4f464.jpg[/img][/td][/tr][tr][td]Harald Hardrada[/td][td]Harald and his sworn brothers, Halldor and Ulf, battle against Fatimids[/td][/tr][/table]

Few embody the warrior’s heart like our trio of legendary heroes: men sworn to adventure, word-fame, and the bonds of brotherhood.

The sagas describe [b]Harald Hardrada[/b] as stronger and taller than most men, a cunning and fiercely ambitious warrior who pursues his goals with relentless fury. Though raised a Christian, he rules with a worldly conviction hardened through many battles. He rises from a wide-eyed youth at the age of fifteen into a vengeful warrior-king, embarking on perilous conquests and cutting down any dissent before it has a chance to take root. It is this uncompromising nature that earns him the name Hardrada: the “Hard Ruler.” He understands the Viking world he is to inherit, a land divided between Christians and pagans, and the iron will required to rule over them.

In-game, Harald is a powerful, axe-throwing ranged hero. His fearsome charges are spoken of in the sagas and are represented through his [b]Battle Horn[/b] ability, which grants nearby units a temporary increase to attack and armor.

[table equalcells=1 noborder=1][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/cb1495b5b9065bdf557b36fe269c26db18703c8c.jpg[/img][/td][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/9034edb2b2f23b21fc766ce9c0cdc7c867779522.png[/img][/td][/tr][tr][td]Halldor Snorrason[/td][td]Halldor Snorrason takes on a group of Saxons[/td][/tr][/table]

Harald’s first sworn brother, [b]Halldor Snorrason[/b], hails from Iceland. Halldor is brash, hardheaded, and fiercely proud of his pagan roots. He favors the dreaded two-handed Dane Axe, cleaving through foes while invoking the old gods. In battle, Halldor’s [b]Berserkergang[/b] ability grants temporarily increased strength, trample damage, and invulnerability — ensuring he can be relied upon to shatter enemy formations.

[table equalcells=1 noborder=1][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/3d3e897faef2da136ab7174626c3ebe8a61fe03f.jpg[/img][/td][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/8529f8df3983262b3ac36e2c6db17d1d93b95c2a.png[/img][/td][/tr][tr][td]Ulf Ospaksson[/td][td]Ulf Ospaksson duels a Viking warlord[/td][/tr][/table]

Harald’s second companion, [b]Ulf Ospaksson[/b], is steadfast and devoutly Christian. Ulf is driven not by wealth but by his loyalty to those who have proven their worth. He commands respect through sheer resolve and discipline, with an unbreakable [b]Aura[/b] that unites those around him — increasing the conversion resistance and gold generation of all nearby Varangian Guards.

newsitems.title: The Viking Sagas Campaign Preview
newsitems.author: Lady Eridani
newsitems.contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/83286a25e58af4f80398005603e36048354976e3.jpg[/img]
[b][i]Conquer the Viking world — forge your saga![/i][/b]

Relive the legend of [b]Harald Hardrada[/b] in [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i] - [i]The Viking Sagas[/i]. This sweeping three-campaign epic takes you across the medieval world: battle in the blood-soaked winter battlefields of Scandinavia, serve as an elite Varangian in the mighty city of Constantinople, and face your destiny in the ultimate Viking invasion of England. From the icy North to the Mediterranean heat, lead history’s most ambitious warrior through a life defined by the axe.

Join the raid and secure your place in the sagas!

[hr][/hr]
[h1]Pre-Order The Viking Sagas Now![/h1]
[i]The Viking Sagas[/i] is available for pre-order now on Steam with a 15% discount!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4376980/Age_of_Empires_II_DE__The_Viking_Sagas/
[hr][/hr]

[h1]The Exiled Prince[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/d196c34978d868db26ea1609d8fecbabf9a957cf.jpg[/img]
[i]The world is changing. Christianity is on the rise, and the Viking realm is torn apart by wars and petty feuds. The old ways are fading, and what it means to be a Viking is no longer certain.

Amid this turmoil, the young Prince Harald is driven out of Norway with just a handful of loyal men and a fierce will to return one day and claim what is rightfully his. A perilous journey lies ahead, but opportunity awaits in the Byzantine court and the famed Varangian Guard. Yet the Empress Zoe is a jealous woman, and she despises any man she cannot control.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/106db11782379db74a06fb030ddedf2e22c6988c.png[/img]
[i]Harald Hardrada commands the shieldwall against his pagan rivals.[/i]

[h1]The Hard Ruler[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/db38afe3911456fa0839714a2c3a4faf5cbba3f3.jpg[/img]
[i]A king is made not by a crown, but by the means to claim it.

Tempered by years of brutal warfare, Harald returns to Scandinavia with a hoard of wealth and plots to take Norway’s throne. Powerful men bar his way: the young and pious king, Magnus Olafsson, and the calculated earl, Svein Estridsson.

Svein is no ordinary man, and he may just have the will to match Harald’s own. Norway’s disloyal nobles, led by the stalwart Einar Paunch-Shaker, are another obstacle – but if their treachery must be rooted out, so be it.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/aa20eddf3eafb9237ed88ff7017fdd4e0b668647.png[/img]
[i]Harald’s forces loot the Danish town of Hedeby.[/i]

[h1]The Last Viking[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/f14e76655fdc2d092c389b784a89bac2198dea13.jpg[/img]
[i]A comet’s tail streaks the sky as the Saxon earl Tostig Godwinson arrives with a daring proposal: England’s throne awaits, if King Harald will sail across the sea to claim it.

For the aging Harald, it is now or never. Unfulfilled ambition casts its shadow over him, but he has the hunger to defy his fate. As Harald launches the greatest fleet Norway has ever known, he dreams of immortalizing his name on England’s shores.

But the Saxons are far from a spent power – and their newly crowned king, Harold Godwinson, is notoriously formidable.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/2e6e74f6e625cf3266381d122a69677d008bfde0.png[/img]
[i]The Vikings and Saxons clash at Stamford Bridge.[/i]

[h1]What to Expect?[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/f6ed586c4ee4155dccc929fa352acd6a7cc43b59.png[/img]
[i]Elite Jomsvikings protect a Legendary Treasure.[/i]

In this DLC, you will enter a character-driven trilogy that spans the life of the legendary Viking warrior Harald Hardrada. Fight alongside Harald and his sworn brothers, Ulf Ospaksson and Halldor Snorrason, and share in their adventures – from terrorizing the Mediterranean in their dreaded longships and harrying the icy fjords of Scandinavia, to reminding the Saxons that Vikings are still a force to be feared.

Plunder your enemies and discover hidden [b]Legendary Treasures[/b] across the Viking world, from the Sun Stone of Leif Ericsson to the Chain Mail of Ivar the Boneless. These treasures can be found in each scenario across the three campaigns, granting powerful bonuses to your heroes, army, or economy. Be wary – these treasures are guarded by mighty warriors and ferocious beasts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/d27b9e9762f52ca78ccfa1f1461bb08976a2fcdd.png[/img]
[i]Concept art for the Varangian, Saxon, and Danish Castles.[/i]

Harald’s travels were as diverse as his many adventures, serving different masters or forging alliances if it meant furthering his ambition. This means you’ll have the chance to play as all three exciting new civilizations, including the Varangians, Danes, and Saxons, and of course, the reworked Vikings. As Harald’s saga is divided into three campaigns, you can play them in any order you like.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/14417681155f452800590b2a0744132f86c45941.png[/img]
[i]The Viking Sagas offers many exciting new assets.[/i]

Dozens of new Viking-themed assets bring the world to life: from driftwood and seaweed in the cold Nordic sea, to heather, gorse, and snowy rocks decorating the wild north, and new animals such as seal, walrus, and elk – and much, much more!
[hr][/hr]
These new campaigns not only draw on what fans have come to love from [i]Age of Empires II[/i], but elevate the storytelling experience and game play immersion further than ever before. In addition to this, we’ve also updated a few legacy scenarios to include the new civilizations: [i]Hastings[/i], [i]Vinlandsaga[/i], and [i]York[/i] have never been more immersive!

We can’t wait to show you what we’ve been working on. Which part of Harald’s saga excites you the most?

newsitems.title: The Viking Sagas выйдет 22 сентября - Age of Empires II получит три новые цивилизации
newsitems.contents:
Feral Interactive и World’s Edge объявили, что дополнение The Viking Sagas для Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition выйдет 22 сентября. Предзаказы уже открыты в Steam, а до релиза расширение можно приобрести со скидкой 15%.

Дополнение посвящено королю Харальду Хардраде и его завоевательным походам по Европе. Игроков ждут три новые цивилизации — варяги, датчане и саксы. Каждая получит собственные юниты, технологии и тактические возможности, а также будет представлена в одной из трёх связанных сюжетных кампаний.

В «Изгнанном принце» Харальд после изгнания из Норвегии отправляется за богатством и славой в чужие земли. Пытаясь вернуть корону, он сталкивается с всё более деспотичной византийской императрицей Зоей.

Кампания «Жестокий правитель» расскажет о борьбе Харальда за престолы Дании и Норвегии. Обладая огромным богатством, он ведёт войну за власть, однако постепенно рискует потерять поддержку собственного народа.

Наконец, «Последний викинг» перенесёт события в Англию. Харальд устремится к английскому трону и попытается создать империю, но его амбиции столкнутся с сопротивлением.

The Viking Sagas расширит Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition новым сюжетным контентом и тремя цивилизациями, объединёнными историей Харальда Хардрады. Дополнение выйдет 22 сентября.

[h1]Civilization Focus: Cavalry & Navy[/h1]

[i]The intrepid Varangian adventurers turned their sights east rather than west, navigating the Baltic Sea and the rivers of Russia to settle and trade in lands as far away as the Black and Caspian Seas. A keen eye for commerce elicits extra gold income from a variety of sources, while their cavalry, navy, and Varangian Guards are among the best in the business. Through trade, raiding, and settlement, the Varangians left a lasting influence throughout much of medieval eastern Europe.[/i]

[*] [b]Team Bonus:[/b] Knight-line increased damage vs. infantry.[/i][/list][/quote]

[h1]Regional Assets[/h1]

[h3]Varangian Guard[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/8fe4ba946236fb1b970ae56bc70b90b8c1a8f46c.jpg[/img]
[i]A mercenary force in service to the Byzantine emperor, the Varangian Guard drew recruits from all over Scandinavia as well as England and Rus’ lands. After completing their service, grizzled veterans returned home fabulously wealthy in both riches and renown.[/i]

Trained at the Barracks, the Varangian Guard is a deadly shock infantryman who generates gold while fighting and excels at raiding and melee combat.
[list][*] [b]Varangian[/b] Guards attack faster, generate more gold, and periodically hurl axes.[/list]

[h3]Longship[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/a8a85ed89f9c362c79d5141d4b5d9580c8f9d1eb.jpg[/img]
[i]Masterfully constructed to traverse any waterway with speed, the Longship was the most advanced and versatile warship in northern Europe through the end of the Viking Age. Rivals bemoaned the lightning-quick longship raids that terrorized coasts and rivers from the North Atlantic Ocean to the Mediterranean, Baltic, Black, and Caspian Seas.[/i]

Constructed at the Dock, this swift warship fires a volley of projectiles and poses a severe threat to warships, soldiers, and buildings alike.
[list][*] [b]Varangian[/b] Longships fire faster.[/list]

[h3]Mounted Crossbowman[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/f7a677ea08f96721ffd1b2eac05634c11af28304.jpg[/img]
[i]While lacking a tradition of horse archery, European armies soon discovered how much more deadly an armor-piercing weapon like the crossbow could be when made more mobile.[/i]

Trained at the Archery Range, the Mounted Crossbowman fires somewhat slower than its nomadic bow-wielding counterpart, but packs quite a punch. Mounted Crossbowmen are available to most European civilizations, which produce them instead of Cavalry Archers.

[h1]Unique Unit[/h1]

[h3]Jarl[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/c9449f7683fdb2f0405ea00f14481bf773f35f63.jpg[/img]
[i]Jarls were charismatic chieftains whose power often rivaled that of local kings. Paragons of Scandinavian warrior culture, they led by example on the battlefield, their deeds inspiring their warbands and demoralizing their opponents. The skeggox (“bearded axe”) was a versatile weapon that could be swung or hurled, and was specifically designed to hamper opponents by hooking their shields, weapons, or limbs.[/i]

Jarls are axe-hurling cavalrymen who are especially strong against infantry. Though hardy and swift, they are best used in combination with other soldiers.

[h1]Unique Technologies[/h1]

[h3]Vendel Legacy[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/c214e9bb5d9ca7ffe6c0a6f96bbb8efe673aa9a7.jpg[/img]
[i]In contrast to the Norse and Danes, the warriors of Migration Period Sweden were skilled cavalrymen. Heroic epics, rich burial sites, and carved art emphasize armored cavalry, pointing to an affiliation with the war-god Odin, who famously rode a peerless 8-legged steed.[/i]

Effect: Knight-line deals trample damage.

[h3]Gothikon[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/8031729e492c744c807e739fef8f3691d9d20ac8.jpg[/img]
[i]A Byzantine account describes the Gothikon, a ritual dance that Varangian mercenaries dressed in animal skins performed as part of a war cult. Harnessing the power and ferocity of savage wild predators, whatever the martial effect, impressed allies and intimidated enemies.[/i]

Effect: Varangian Guards periodically throw axes.

[h1]Varangian Castle[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/6888638d425f376487d4139e3d0f8d1cea6ef413.jpg[/img]
The Varangian Castle, combining elements of Varangian forts and the Golden Gate of Kyiv.

[h1]Varangian Wonder[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/0a08ff5aad258bc0289bdde34140b16bd18570cd.jpg[/img]
The Varangian Wonder, a jarl’s ship burial mound described by Ibn Fadlan in the 10th century CE.

[h1]Civilization Focus: Infantry & Defense[/h1]

[i]Prosperous inheritors of Roman Britain, the Saxons use strong fortifications and infantry armies to vigilantly guard their realms against the constant threat of Viking raids. The organized and efficient fyrd system facilitates levying foot soldiers from Saxon towns and estates, while Alfred the Great’s naval reforms have created a fleet capable of challenging even the Danes at sea. Resilient and adaptive, the Saxons may bend but won’t break, and present a stiff challenge to any invader.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/fac06d20936a8b13b1a5bf01727ba3892e16e08f.jpg[/img]
[quote][b]Bonuses[/b]
[list][*] Dropsites provide a little extra food and stone when built.
[*] Foot soldiers cost less per Town Center or Castle controlled.
[*] Towers and Castles fire more arrows starting in the Castle Age.
[*] Longships and Catapult Galleons have more HP.
[*] Team Bonus: Repairers work faster.[/list][/quote]

[h1]Regional Assets[/h1]

[h3]Varangian Guard[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/8fe4ba946236fb1b970ae56bc70b90b8c1a8f46c.jpg[/img]
[i]A mercenary force in service to the Byzantine emperor, the Varangian Guard drew recruits from all over Scandinavia as well as England and Rus’ lands. After completing their service, grizzled veterans returned home fabulously wealthy in both riches and renown.[/i]

Trained at the Barracks, the Varangian Guard is a deadly shock infantryman who generates gold while fighting and excels at raiding and melee combat.
[list][*] [b]Saxon[/b] Varangian Guards are less expensive per Town Center and Castle controlled and gain additional armor when massed.[/list]

[h3]Longship[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/a8a85ed89f9c362c79d5141d4b5d9580c8f9d1eb.jpg[/img]
[i]Masterfully constructed to traverse any waterway with speed, the Longship was the most advanced and versatile warship in northern Europe through the end of the Viking Age. Rivals bemoaned the lightning-quick longship raids that terrorized coasts and rivers from the North Atlantic Ocean to the Mediterranean, Baltic, Black, and Caspian Seas.[/i]

Constructed at the Dock, this swift warship fires a volley of projectiles and poses a severe threat to warships, soldiers, and buildings alike.
[list][*] [b]Saxon[/b] Longships benefit from additional HP.[/list]

[h3]Mounted Crossbowman[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/f7a677ea08f96721ffd1b2eac05634c11af28304.jpg[/img]
[i]While lacking a tradition of horse archery, European armies soon discovered how much more deadly an armor-piercing weapon like the crossbow could be when made more mobile.[/i]

Trained at the Archery Range, the Mounted Crossbowman fires somewhat slower than its nomadic bow-wielding counterpart, but packs quite a punch. Mounted Crossbowmen are available to most European civilizations, which produce them instead of Cavalry Archers.

[h1]Unique Unit[/h1]

[h3]Hearth Troop[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/b512960f66a746b4aae1fef891c51894be5b0d3e.png[/img]
[i]Hearth Troops were a Saxon leader’s professional retinue, so named because they literally shared his hearth and hall. Armed with the best equipment available, they usually bore a shield and at least one blade and spear, the latter of which could be thrusted or hurled. Hearth Troops were glorified in Saxon heroic poetry such as the Battle of Maldon, the Fight at Finnsburh, and Beowulf, often fighting to the bitter end even after their lord was slain.[/i]

This elite infantryman excels in melee combat with his sword and shield, but also periodically hurls a javelin at enemies.

[h1]Unique Technologies[/h1]

[h3]Clerical Recruitment[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/d587f07a6d9bd314a6c87a198924f604f47aacd8.png[/img]
[i]Rich ecclesiastical culture and promises of salvation made enrolling new members easy for the Saxon clergy. These immensely pious clerics swiftly became well-educated and persuasive.[/i]

Effect: Monks gain +1 range and train 33% faster.

[h3]Shield Wall[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/46dd79d831d1e8f8f003a577329e6d877cf3f48c.png[/img]
[i]Adopted from the Roman legions, a wall of interlocking shields was the supreme infantry tactic in early medieval northern Europe. It required immense discipline and coordination to maintain in a chaotic battle, but the victorious results of successful use were undeniable.[/i]

Effect: Infantry gain additional armor in larger groups.

[h1]Saxon Castle[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/fe5563c28e2f13afce1de9dd138ba09cc1930310.png[/img]
The Saxon Castle, based on the citadels of stout Saxon burhs depicted in the Bayeux Tapestry.

[h1]Saxon Wonder[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/c3b60a456cfa127695cbcbf8b73e9b94bb68f121.png[/img]
The Saxon Wonder, an iconic turriform church.

[h1]Civilization Focus: Infantry & Siege Weapons[/h1]

[i]Feared across northern Europe for their aggressive expansion and brutal raids during the Viking Age, the Danes dominate the North Sea region with stout infantry and powerful siege engines. Centuries of coastal raiding makes them swift sailors, while a tradition of hunting, gathering, and farming makes their Fishing Ships and Villagers more productive at gathering food. True to their reaving nature, the Danes are expert pillagers, plundering gold and resources from every destroyed building.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/f3a4188112e5d554769f4875992fb54c213d3c14.jpg[/img]
[i]Sworn members of a sacred blood brotherhood, the Jomsvikings were professional warriors with a reputation for loyalty, ferocity, and fighting skill. Striking out from their base at the Jomsborg, the Jomsvikings terrorized the Baltic and avenged fallen comrades without fail.[/i]

This nimble raider carries a spear and a shield into battle. Jomsvikings hurl torches at enemy buildings and ships to set them ablaze, making them versatile as well as potent.

newsitems.contents:
[previewyoutube=xHw-byEJ0Bo;full][/previewyoutube]
Having seen the [i]Age of Empires[/i] community’s enthusiasm for Viking adventures and sagas, we are thrilled to bring the next DLC for [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i] - [b][i]The Viking Sagas[/i][/b]! It is available now for pre-order on Steam with a 15% discount and launches on [b]September 22, 2026[/b]. Sail to medieval northern Europe, where history meets heroic epic in daring adventures, thrilling sagas, and ruthless raids. Navigate the calm fjords, rushing rivers, treacherous seas, and lands beyond in an action-packed expansion, marauding and pillaging to your heart’s content!

[b][i]The Viking Sagas[/i][/b] introduces three formidable new civilizations with their own unique units, technologies, and shared architecture: the [b]Danes[/b], [b]Saxons[/b], and [b]Varangians[/b]. Challenge your friends in skirmish matches or ransack your way across Northern Europe in an epic 15-mission, 3-part new campaign, commanding the warriors of the fabled Harald Hardrada.

In this epic trilogy, you will set sail on adventures that span from the icy North to the southern reaches of the Byzantine empire, to the wide beaches of the English shore. Meet the rebellious pagan Einar Paunch-Shaker, escape the advances of the calculating Empress Zoe, and test the sharp edge of your battle axe against the Danish king Svein Estridsson.

We are excited to work with Forgotten Empires to bring you [i][b]The Viking Sagas[/b][/i]. Whether you are a passionate historian, an admirer of Norse sagas, a longtime fan of the [i]Age of Empires[/i] franchise, or all of the above – [b][i]The Viking Sagas[/i][/b] will bring you countless hours of joy and fun!
[hr][/hr]
[h1]Pre-Order The Viking Sagas Now![/h1]

[i]The Viking Sagas[/i] is available for pre-order now on Steam with a 15% discount!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4376980/Age_of_Empires_II_DE__The_Viking_Sagas/
[hr][/hr]

[h1]What are The Viking Sagas?[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/fa60216e23fcdcbd6f72b21f4b9fbb43b2a6d02e.png[/img]
[quote][i]"With God as my witness, I swear these three things: first, to gain followers and make a name for myself; second, to recapture the throne of Norway; and lastly, to do what my brother failed to do—and unify the kingdoms of Norway, Denmark, and England into one great Viking empire."[/i][/quote]
[i]The Viking Sagas[/i] is a DLC set in Northern Europe primarily during the Viking Age. Masters of warfare on land and at sea, the Danes, Saxons, and Varangians offer [i]Age of Empires II[/i] players the game’s core unit roster along with several unique and region-specific assets representing iconic features of each region. Veterans and newcomers alike will enjoy approachable, powerful, and immersive new civilizations!

As the sun sets on the Viking age, Harald Hardrada, embarks on an odyssey to become the greatest Viking there ever was. Sail the dramatic fjords of Scandinavia, fight your way through the streets of magnificent Constantinople, and seize the throne of England in the decisive year 1066! Forge bonds of brotherhood with the stoic Christian Ulf Ospaksson and passionate pagan Halldor Snorrason; throw your axe against hordes of fierce enemies; and prove yourself worthy of beautiful Ellisif, the princess of Kyiv.

[h1]Included in this DLC[/h1]

[h2]3 New Civilizations![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/2f3bc2d95cd027386b472b5ba07068ce917df406.jpg[/img][list][*] [b]Danes[/b] – Sail swift longships to raid and pillage your enemies’ lands to your heart’s content! The Danish unique unit is the [i]Jomsviking[/i], a nimble and hardy infantryman that hurls a torch when attacking enemy buildings and ships.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/31897093d41190f8ef35f15de17f82beb135081b.jpg[/img][list][*] [b]Saxons[/b] – Construct mighty fortified towns and unify England in the face of ruthless Scandinavian invasions. The Saxon unique unit is the [i]Hearth Troop[/i], a heavy infantryman that hurls a javelin before engaging in melee combat.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/cdb0471dac9d572ca5c005da5e07a8f7e7cf0201.jpg[/img][list][*] [b]Varangians[/b] – Fearlessly navigate Europe’s waterways, ride down your foes, and enlist as mercenaries to wealthy empires! The Varangian unique unit is the [i]Jarl[/i], an axe-hurling cavalryman that shreds enemy infantry.[/list]
[h2]Immersive and Region-Specific Assets[/h2]
Several region-specific assets for increased immersion in Northern European history:
[list][*] [i]Varangian Guards[/i] — deadly shock infantry who generate gold while fighting and excel at raiding and melee combat. Varangian Guards serve the Byzantines, Danes, Saxons, Varangians, and Vikings.
[*] [i]Mounted Crossbowmen[/i] — hard-hitting but slow-firing ranged soldiers who strike fear into infantry armies. Available to the Danes, Saxons, Varangians, and Vikings, as well as most European civilizations.
[*] [i]Longships[/i] — swift warships that combine potency and versatility. The Danes, Saxons, Varangians, and Vikings can all construct Longships.[/list]

[h2]1 Epic 15-Mission, 3-Part Campaign![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/ea53746ef45626db801036797c66cc9641d6ea06.jpg[/img]
[i]The Varangian district of Kyiv[/i]
[list][*] [b]Book I: The Exiled Prince (Varangians)[/b] — After being forced into exile, the young Prince Harald of Norway swears to reclaim his kingdom. Can he earn enough wealth, fame, and power on his adventures in the east to realize his dream?[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/4fd4dde7c6cddc6c1fce644f8aff3b2abf76f152.jpg[/img]
[i]The siege of Hedeby’s fortress in Denmark[/i]
[list][*] [b]Book II: The Hard Ruler (Danes)[/b] — Harald returns to Norway to reclaim his kingdom, but is challenged at every turn by rival Viking rulers. Will he be able to unify the thrones of Norway and Denmark?[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/b7a08286a95a27684c43337730b665606846826b.jpg[/img]
[i]The Saxons are defending the city of Scarborough, in northern England, against the Viking assaults.[/i]
[list][*] [b]Book III: The Last Vikings (Saxons)[/b] — The King of England is dead. Harald Hardrada claims its throne in the greatest gamble of his life. Can he conquer the Saxon kingdom and finally build the Viking empire of his dreams?[/list]
[b]As you venture through this campaign, you will:[/b]
[list][*] Live the legend of the most famous Viking in history — Harald Hardrada — across three narratively interconnected campaigns.
[*] Fight as a mercenary for the Byzantine empire, reclaim the throne of Norway, and build the Viking empire of your dreams!
[*] Battle alongside two memorable companions: the stoic swordsman Ulf Ospaksson and the passionate pagan Halldor Snorrason.
[*] Outwit powerful enemies like the vicious Byzantine Empress Zoe, the cunning King Svein Estridsson of Denmark, and Harold Godwinson, the ruthless Saxon King of England.
[*] Make important, interactive decisions with effects that ripple throughout each campaign!
[*] Use your Viking heroes and their unique heroic abilities — such as Harald’s Battle Horn or Halldor’s Berserkergang — to strengthen your army.
[*] March through hills of heather, fight under the cover of snowy spruce, and hunt formidable elk and seal, as you fully immerse yourself in the Viking Age with new flora and fauna.[/list]
[h1]All 3 New Civilizations Available in Ranked Play![/h1]
As always, we are committed to delivering a product with content for everyone at all levels, styles, spheres, and preferences of the [i]Age of Empires experience[/i]. Scandinavian armies follow a familiar European model, but utilize unique components geared towards lightning-quick raids and the accumulation of loot. With familiar technology trees and design concepts, [b][i]The Viking Sagas[/i] civilizations fit easily into ranked gameplay.[/b]

With a familiar [i]Age of Empires II[/i] feel, plenty of Viking raids to satisfy intrepid players, and the innovative features that [i]Age of Empires II[/i] fans have come to expect from each new addition to our beloved game, [b][i]The Viking Sagas[/i][/b] offers an adventure to everyone.

[hr][/hr]
[b][i]The Viking Sagas[/i][/b] is vintage [i]Age of Empires II[/i] with an extra exploring, raiding, and pillaging focus. Harnessing trademark authenticity, fun, and innovation, [i][b]The Viking Sagas[/b][/i] sets sail to new levels of excitement, intertwining history and heroic epic into a riveting adventure. Whether you are entirely new to the [i]Age of Empires[/i] franchise or a dedicated and loyal fan, [b][i]The Viking Sagas[/i][/b] is for you!

As we continue our endless quest to raise the bar for the [i]Age of Empires[/i] franchise and its fans, we remain thrilled by your passion to share in this journey. When you brandish another set of enthralling civilizations, marvel at breathtaking visuals, and dive into another epic storyline, know that as always, we appreciate your continued passion for this incredible franchise!

newsitems.title: Celebrating Age in 2026 – Where We’re At, and Where We’re Going
newsitems.author: Lady Eridani
newsitems.contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/1ccbc47ae9f05857358b53283cbb58678d829b03.jpg[/img]
The first six months of 2026 have been filled with memorable moments across the [i]Age[/i] franchise. We’ve explored new legends and civilizations, welcomed players to new platforms, cheered alongside fans at Red Bull Wololo: Londinium, and watched our communities continue to create, compete, stream, mod, and share their passion for all the [i]Age[/i] games in ways that inspire us every day. 

Before we look ahead to what’s next, join us as we take a look at some of the highlights from 2026 so far – and share a glimpse of what still lies ahead for [i]Age of Empires[/i]. 
[list][*] [url=https://www.ageofempires.com/news/new-dlc-available-now-the-last-chieftains/][i]The Last Chieftains[/i][/url] took [i]Age II: DE[/i] to South America, bringing 3 new civs and 3 new campaigns telling stories of historical struggles of brave men and women who stood up to violence from both internal and external forces. 
[*] The [url=https://www.ageofempires.com/buy-now#AoM][i]Age of Mythology: Retold Expansion Pass[/i][/url] delivered a continuous rollout of content, adding the [i]Demeter Gods Pack[/i], [i]Ultimate Fan Pack[/i], [i]Blood & Bones Pack[/i], and the long-awaited arrival of the Aztecs in [url=https://www.ageofempires.com/news/age-of-mythology-retold-obsidian-mirror-available-now-and-update-19-10195/][i]Obsidian Mirror[/i][/url].  
[*] Age fans headed to London, UK for a truly record-breaking event, [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8kVyBYBcc34]Red Bull Wololo: Londinium[/url]! From meeting fans in person to watching games from the edges of our seats, our memories will last forever! 
[*] [url=https://www.ageofempires.com/news/age-of-empires-iv-yue-feis-legacy-available-now/][i]Yue Fei’s Legacy[/i][/url] expanded [i]Age of Empires IV[/i] even further, with the game heading to China to bring to life the conflict between Yue Fei’s leadership of the Song Dynasty against the Jin Dynasty invaders. Players got their first new campaign since [i]Sultans Ascend[/i] and a host of new challenges. 
[*] More than six years after launch and [i]Age II: DE[/i] is still expanding. Not just through new content, like [i]The Last Chieftains[/i], but also arriving on new platforms. With our amazing partner Feral Interactive, we brought the beloved game to [url=https://www.feralinteractive.com/en/games/ageofempires2/mac/]macOS in May via Steam[/url]. 
[*] The world got its first look at the upcoming [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7NPJPZX896Y][i]Raiders of the North[/i][/url] expansion for [i]Age of Empires IV[/i] during the 2026 XBOX Showcase, where we headed North to the land of Vikings, but we were also thrilled to share that the other new civ coming is the Scots! 
[*] We closed out the first half of the year with bringing [i]Age of Empires Mobile: PC Edition[/i] to Steam and Microsoft Store (as well as to XBOX Game Pass). Governors can now enjoy growing their kingdom and massive alliance battles on mouse and keyboard and in glorious 4K. [/list]
Across the 75 million players we’ve had playing [i]Age[/i] in one game or another, we want to thank you for your passion and willingness to let us know what you feel both complimentary and critical about our games. Your insight through social channels or in person at one of our many events helps shape the future of the games; every campaign completed; every multiplayer match fought; every screenshot or meme shared; every piece of feedback provided helps us continue to grow and evolve [i]Age[/i] for years to come. 

[b]Here’s a preview of what you can expect for the rest of 2026. Thank you, as always, for your support, feedback, and the time you spend with our games. [/b]

[quote][h1]A New Look at Age of Empires IV’s Upcoming Expansion – Raiders of the North[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/8f0d879480448abea1306f1c10cb6cb76a371dc2.jpg[/img]
Back in December 2025, we told you to expect two expansions for [i]Age of Empires IV[/i] in 2026 – [i]Yue Fei’s Legacy[/i] is out now, and we shared that the second would contain two new civilizations. While you were all excited to hear that one would be the Vikings, we’ve maintained a mystery around the second. We were thrilled that our reveal got to take the stage at the XBOX Showcase. [i]Raiders of the North[/i] is coming this Fall and will also add the Scots to the game. 

The two new civs aren’t all that you can expect though. We’ll also be expanding fan favorite mode The Crucible with four new missions, new boons, a new challenge mode, and two-player co-op! You’ll also get two new stunning biomes in which to battle. 

In [i]Raiders of the North[/i], the Vikings emerge not just as raiders of the past, but as a dynamic civilization which bridges the gap between the sagas of old and the rise of medieval Scandinavia. 
[list][*] They are defined by fast and powerful melee infantry, competence at sea, early religion, and the communal Longhouse at the heart of their economy. 
[*] Complete Sagas that grant lasting bonuses and establish early Sacred Groves on Relic sites to bring Hamingja to your side when fighting nearby. 
[*] The Viking Bondi is a more powerful Spearman replacement that is trained from both the Longhouse and Barracks, carrying a shield for additional defense and gaining a shield wall ability when grouped together. 
[*] The higher ranking Hirdman replaces the Man-at-Arms as a hard hitting, resilient, and fast front-line infantry that comes with a higher cost. 
[*] Rounding out the Viking melee infantry roster and roaring to life on the box art is the Berserker, dangerously fast, light on their feet, and with the ability to enter a frenzied state of berserkergang it would be wise to keep a close eye on your wood line.[/list] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/502c321e67feceb1c4fb7c29276f34ac921b70c5.jpg[/img]
The Scots will prove admirable adversaries not just to the Vikings, but across the [i]Age IV[/i] civ roster. The Scots are a resilient people who spent centuries forging alliances and defending their rugged lands. 
[list][*] The enemies of the Scots have learned to be weary of ambush nearby stealth forests, as the Scots infantry can see right through it and may jump out with an unrivalled ferocity. 
[*] The Scots Mustering Hall provides a quick way to field units at a discount, including the mighty Gallowglass and nimble Border Reivers. 
[*] With a claymore in both hands and draped in mail, the Gallowglass are the Highland warriors she tells you not to worry about. 
[*] When the Gallowglass stand shoulder to shoulder with the Scottish Pike and Lochaber Axes, the Scots infantry form a powerful schiltron to stop enemy cavalry charges in their tracks.
[*]  Highland Cattle are known for their hardiness and ability to eat nearly anything, here they eat your berry bushes which provide a steady and sustainable food source. 
[*] To protect your precious herd, the Scots Tower Houses provide vision and safety from enemy raids, especially with an attached barmkin to bring the “coos” inside. [/list]

newsitems.title: Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition – Update 177723
newsitems.author: Lady Eridani
newsitems.contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/47418469b96b5cc2c2bfbec875aa270a2765a763.jpg[/img]
Welcome to a new update for [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i]! With today’s Update we’re delivering a rather massive list of bug fixes, changes, and new features to help keep your experience vibrant! This patch delivers a set of stability improvements and bug fixes, addressing crashes, performance issues, and inconsistencies across both PC and consoles.

Gameplay has been refined with fixes to unit behavior, technologies, and civilization bonuses to ensure mechanics work as intended. Pathfinding and economic interactions, such as Mule Cart positioning, have also been improved for smoother play.

Bugfixing pass for UI, audio, and multiplayer systems, chat, lobbies, civilization selection, and Bluetooth audio quality. Smaller AI behavior changes for campaigns and co-op missions have also been implemented for better reliability.

Additional balance changes adjust unit costs, training times, and civilization bonuses to support a more consistent gameplay experience.

Be sure to dig down into the post below to get all of the smaller details before hopping in-game and checking them out firsthand. Enjoy the update!

[quote][i][b]Developer Note:[/b] We did want to follow up on information we shared in previous patch notes, however, and talk a bit more about Console bugs and the problems some of you have been having with your experience.

We’ve seen that you’ve been scanning PUP information and looking for specifics around some of the problems you’ve been reporting to us, such as crashes, invisible units, and general instability of various kinds as you get further into Console matches. There aren’t bullets highlighting those specific issues because their shared root cause has been less of a bug fix and more of a significant engineering refactor of a few things under the hood, but we’re happy to say that today’s Update should resolve many of these problems for you!  

We’ll be monitoring your feedback and looking for anything we need to continue to work on as it comes up. This particular set of problems has been a tricky one for us, as there hasn’t been any kind of quick fix we could make happen, but much heavier low-level engineering work that wound up being needed to address some of the problems you’ve been reporting. This has taken us some time and we know that’s been frustrating for many, and we appreciate both your patience as well as your continued support! As we mentioned in our previous patch notes, we’ve got an increased focus on Console going into the next year and more work we intend to do to further uplift your experience, so this really just kicks off that focus and we’ll be back with an increased set of Console-specific bug fixes and attention in future Updates.[/i][/quote]
[quote][b]This is just a small taste of what is coming in the latest update. For a more complete list, please visit our site and check out our blog. Happy Gaming![/b]

—The [i]Age of Empires[/i] Team
[hr][/hr][code][h1]        ◆ Update 177723 ◆[/h1][/code][hr][/hr]
[quote][h2]Game[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/1db5c65a88bbfe0c20e6ed2d39eb75f446dc5dc4.png[/img]
[h3]Stability & Performance[/h3]
[list][*] Fixed a crash while viewing a Player Profile if the game was force stopped using the Steam client.
[*] Fixed a crash happening on 4v4 skirmish games with 8 AI players.
[*] Fixed a crash on consoles that would occur when pressing Left Bumper on the gamepad while in the Villager radial Build Menu.
[*] Fixed a crash related to Lou Chuans attacking after the Thunderclap Bombs Unique Technology was researched.
[*] Fixed a rare crash that would occur when canceling the creation of a Villager at the Town Center.
[*] Fixed a rare crash where siege units in groups could affect movement speed.
[*] Fixed a rare crash that could appear if a player tries to click the “Block Player” button while also leaving the post-game statistics screen.
[*] Fixed performance degradation spikes that occurred whenever a terrain tile was modified.
[*] Improved game performance when the Building and Aura Range indicator appears for many units and buildings.
[*] Improved the stability of File Transfers in Custom Games lobbies and prevented players from being kicked upon transfer failures.
[*] Fixed a crash that reduced the memory usage during map generation.[/list]
[h3]Achievements[/h3]
[list][*] Fixed the “Can I be Frank with you?” achievement being granted regardless if the “Tours (732)” Co-op Historical Battle has been completed or not.[/list]
[h3]Graphics[/h3]
[list][*]Fixed Hulk Ships for Byzantines, Italians, Spanish, Portuguese, Armenians, and Georgian civilizations  appearing with African ship sails while attacking.
[*] Reduced the size of some graphics assets (saving ~2GB with EGP installed).[/list]
[h3]Audio[/h3]
[list][*] Fixed low-quality audio when using Bluetooth devices.[/list]
[h3]UI[/h3]
[list][*] A new ‘More Content’ section can be accessed from the Main Menu, listing all available owned and not owned content DLCs. DLC that is not owned will also be displayed on the Main Menu screen.
[*] Fixed an issue where changing lobbies between the Base Game and Return of Rome variant would cause a Civilization to become automatically selected when entering the lobby.
[*] Fixed an issue where using Mouse and Keyboard on consoles would cause the Search Bar on the Civilization Select screen to be unresponsive.
[*] Fixed an issue that locked “Women’s History Month Icons” for players that had them unlocked.
[*] Fixed Civilization Emblem background images found in the Civilization Selection menu appearing blurry and low resolution.
[*] Fixed Civilization Shield icon not appearing in Ranked and Quickplay lobbies when Civilization is set to Random.
[*] Fixed Match Settings not appearing on the loading screen for games that used the Time Limit Victory Condition.
[*] Fixed typo in lobby chat notification after being locked from sending messages. Fixed text: “You cannot send any more chat messages at the moment. Please wait a few seconds and try again.”
[*] In the Tech Tree menu, Trade Cart icons now appear with regional Civilization icons.[/list]
[h3]Hotkeys[/h3]
[list][*] Fixed an issue that, when the game is set to Windowed, using an ALT + hotkey combination would produce a Windows beep sound.
[*] “Select all Town Centers” hotkey now correctly includes Town Centers’ foundations.[/list]
[h3]PC[/h3]
[list][*] Improved memory usage on PCs.[/list]
[h3]Xbox[/h3]
[list][*] Improved memory usage on Xbox One and Xbox Series consoles.
[*] Fixed an issue on Xbox consoles that would allow profiles that do not own the game to launch the title and enter a game match, which would result in a crash.
[*] Fixed an issue showing player slots as “Ready” (green text) when players set themselves as Ready and then left the lobby.
[*] Fixed the Map Pool Menu to display the map list on parity with all the other platforms.
[*] Fixed a crash that would occur after multiple games were played in succession on Xbox One and Xbox Series consoles.[/list]
[h3]PlayStation[/h3]
[list][*] Fixed an issue showing player slots as “Ready” (green text) when players set themselves as Ready and then left the lobby.[/list][/quote]

[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/879fa86fabdf006ccfe451ab68d4d160bd2f2273.png"][/img]Over the last few years, we’ve brought one of the most beloved real-time strategy games of all time to Xbox, and PlayStation 5. Today, a new era dawns: [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i], is now available natively for modern Macs on [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/813780/Age_of_Empires_II_Definitive_Edition/"]Steam[/url]!

Working with our partner Feral Interactive, Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition is now available for macOS, bringing one of the most popular real-time strategy games available on Windows to Mac fans for the first time. If you're an existing owner of the game on Steam, you now can play the macOS version! To find out more, head over to Feral Interactive’s blog where they offer a [url="https://www.feralinteractive.com/en/games/ageofempires2/mac/blog/#basics"]Newcomer’s Guide[/url], an [i][url="https://www.feralinteractive.com/en/games/ageofempires2/mac/blog/#history"]Age of Empires[/url][/i][url="https://www.feralinteractive.com/en/games/ageofempires2/mac/blog/#history"] Retrospective[/url], plus [url="https://www.feralinteractive.com/en/games/ageofempires2/mac/blog/#whats-in-store"]detailed descriptions of all the DLC[/url].
[/p][hr][/hr][h1]Available Now for MacOS on Steam[/h1][p]
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/813780/Age_of_Empires_II_Definitive_Edition/"][/dynamiclink]
[/p][hr][/hr][h2]What is Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition?[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/686ba90579b83c25663830c2b25bca2fe675f71a.jpg"][/img][i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i] is an invitation to lead a broad range of civilizations, from marauding Huns to fiery Celts, as they carve their paths through a thousand years of history. Players grow their settlements from Dark Age hamlets to imposing citadels by balancing resource gathering with military spending to defend what is already theirs and to conquer what is not. 

[/p][h2]Narrative Campaigns, Skirmish Modes, and Multiplayer[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/acdac8f408f1968952fe0858a644b31c8412e06c.jpg"][/img]Each single-player campaign is packed with historical flavour, featuring famous leaders from Kings to Khans, and incorporating the technologies and weaponry of each era. The fast-paced Skirmish mode pits players against up to eight opponents, either offline versus the AI, or online against other Mac gamers. Online multiplayer also offers cooperative campaigns featuring historical scenarios and objectives to tackle together as allies.

[/p][h2]The Definitive Way to Play[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/55734b2c860612664a6a3d24f23523367feae923.png"][/img]As the latest iteration of this storied game, [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i] arrives on macOS as an Apple silicon native version, with the benefit of more than two decades of refinements. These include 4K visuals, a remastered soundtrack, new animations, and numerous quality-of-life improvements.

[/p][h2]What’s Included?[/h2][table noborder="1" equalcells="1" colwidth=",,"][tr][td][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/e58ee4e77e973514e6b2143fd492a5b25fe69140.png"][/img][/p][/td][td][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/e668744eb684e2a6f512a29d3095253b37cddceb.jpg"][/img][/p][/td][td][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/46c7540274a1187d96e167323f84d4477db2d110.png"][/img][/p][/td][/tr][/table][p]The base game also includes three expansions – [i]Lords of the West[/i], [i]Dawn of the Dukes[/i], and [i]Dynasties of India[/i] – each introducing new campaigns and civilizations. A huge range of purchasable DLC is also available, including the recently released [i]The Last Chieftains[/i], in which medieval history and folklore contend in campaigns across the varied terrains of South America. 

[/p][hr][/hr][h1]Available Now for MacOS on Steam[/h1][p]

[/p][h3]Check out the PUP Notes[/h3][p]Steam owners can view the patch notes here: [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/813780/discussions/36/806849453058204524/"]🛠 May Public Update Preview Notes![/url] [i](Note that you must own the game and log in to Steam to access the PUP forum.)[/i]
 
[/p][h3]How to participate in the PUP[/h3][p]Steam owners can download the [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i] PUP by following the instructions below: 

1. Navigate to your Steam library and right click on [i][b]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition.[/b][/i] 
2. Select "Properties…" at the bottom of the menu. 
3. Select the "Game Versions & Betas" tab on the left.

[quote][i][b]Developer Note:[/b] While this brief update is mostly a communication about what’s to come, we’d also like to add some context that we’ve got a lot of capacity dedicated to improving quality of life for our Console players over the next year and in general. 

Our Console and our PC versions of the game are quite different under the hood. The Console versions include several unique UI and gameplay systems alongside underlying technology and engineering differences that mean certain kinds of issues will often need to be handled in slightly or significantly different ways in two different places. Depending on what kind of work effort we’re talking about, fixing issues or making changes often involves a slow step-by-step process in a linear order, with a fair bit of diagnostic process along the way.

Right now we’re focused on delivering fixes for players having problems with their game on Console and getting that in your hands as quickly as we’re able (timing still TBD). We know that you’re anxious for solutions and we sincerely appreciate your patience as we take the time needed to make sure we deliver reliable fixes and avoid additional problems. We definitely hear your concerns and we want you to know that we’re committed to supporting the overall health of our Console community for the long term!

Looking ahead, you should start to see an increased volume of fixes and changes in future patch notes that serve to uplift the experience on Console even further. This will come from an increased concentration on your Console experience overall, and you’ll see this play out over an extended period of time as we continue to service the game and build on the experience across all platforms.

newsitems.author: editor@pcgamesn.com
newsitems.contents:
As a League of Legends enthusiast that's writing this article in a Fnatic t-shirt, I'm very much of the mind that esports isn't dead. Oftentimes seen as a fad that came and went in the early 2020s, competitive gaming is certainly its own niche with its own problems, but it's here to stay. When you think of esports, however, you conjure up an image of the fast-paced action of a Counter-Strike Major, or the glitz and glamor of League of Legends Worlds. You don't immediately think of Age of Empires 2, a strategy game that was first released in 1999. But AoE esports is thriving, and Red Bull Wololo: Londinium proves it.
